android.desc:
LendSense is the ultimate debt management app designed to help you easily track, manage, and monitor all your borrowing and lending activities in one place. Whether you lend money to friends, borrow from colleagues, or track your side hustle earnings, LendSense gives you the tools to stay on top of your finances.
Key Features:

Track Money Borrowed
Easily record and manage all your borrowings. Never forget who you owe or when payments are due.

Track Money Lent
Monitor money you've lent to others with clear records and timelines for repayment.

Track Interest Earned
Stay informed on the interest you're earning from your loans with automatic calculations.

Custom Credit Score System
LendSense features a unique credit score system to help you assess risk and build better lending habits.

Custom Debtor Profiles
Lendsense automatically creat's detailed profiles for each debtor or lender with notes, repayment history, and contact info ;perfect for personal or small business use.

User-Friendly Interface
Designed with simplicity in mind. LendSense offers a clean, intuitive interface for effortless financial management.

Why Choose LendSense?

Stay organized with clear records of debts and loans

Gain insights into your lending habits and borrower reliability

Make smarter money decisions with credit scoring

Perfect for individuals, freelancers, and small business owners


Get Financial Clarity Today!

Stop guessing. Start tracking. Download LendSense now and take full control of your debts and loans.
